answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that grows with the number of identities it operates, so building a reef of fake personas becomes expensive instead of free. Peers then audit a random sample of each newcomer's work, checking it the way a reader checks that a sonnet follows its form, and slash the stake when the work is copied or inconsistent. Honest agents that wander between tasks keep their stake and earn fees, while sybils lose money faster than they can gain influence.
